stories.headline: Dominator 2027 goes 3 days with Friday mainstage debut
stories.summary: Dominator Festival expands to three days on 15–17 July 2027 at E3-Strand, Eersel, under the theme 'FUEL THE CHAOS'. New additions include a Thursday opening night and the first-ever Friday mainstage show. Tickets go on sale 25 January.

stories.headline: REBiRTH 2027 drops massive lineup across 20 stages
stories.summary: REBiRTH Festival runs April 9–11, 2027 with 300+ artists, 13 Evolution Specials, and brand-new live acts from Refuzion, Brennan Heart, D-Sturb, and more. The event promises its biggest edition yet, covering every harder style from hardstyle to uptempo and raw.

stories.headline: REBiRTH Festival hit by €2 fun tax threat from 2027
stories.summary: The municipality of Vught plans a €2-per-visitor entertainment levy from Jan 2027, potentially costing REBiRTH Festival around €150,000. Organizer Ferry van den Nieuwelaar calls the proposal disproportionate; talks with officials are upcoming.

stories.headline: Thyron drops 'back 2 life' album after tough two years
stories.summary: Hardstyle artist Thyron released his 13-track album 'back 2 life' via Scantraxx, chronicling a serious accident, recovery, and personal rebuild. The three-chapter project moves from darkness to hope, with 7 tracks debuting today.

stories.headline: Unfold Records drops massive 5-artist raw collab
stories.summary: Worlds Collide unites B-Struct, NOCTURNAL, SVANE, Heavy Resistance & Dark Entities ft. MC Activate on Unfold Records. The track premiered at REBELLiON Indoor after a full scrapped version and a fresh restart.

caption: Dominator goes 3 days, REBiRTH drops 20 stages, Thyron is back — this week in hard dance was MASSIVE 🔥
